reason: Research was limited: two WebSearch queries found no reliable 2026-11-05 recap of the energy and semiconductor selloff and no outlook for the week of 11-09. The results were from other years, so I cannot confirm whether energy weakness is structural or a passing move. Every position is still inside its stop-loss and take-profit at the 11-06 marks. XLE is the weakest at -9.12% against a -12% stop, and the stop will handle a further drop without my intervention. VTV, XLF and XBI are positive, and their stops and targets are intact. The 32% cash position earns 4% APY, and the book already sits within the defensive mandate. Selling XLE now on an unverified selloff would lock in a loss close to its stop, and a rotation would cost basis points for a thesis I could not confirm. Holding keeps the stop structure working as designed.
